notes: Two API families: Data API (credit-based, from $50 for 250,000 credits) and Project API (key passed via token parameter). Trial signup advertises 'No credit card required' but sustained API usage requires a paid plan (Core $129/mo, Growth $279/mo) or API Add-On from $149/month. Vendor ships an official MCP server (180+ tools, per seranking.com/mcp.html) plus a maintained Postman collection. Keys are self-created in the account's API Dashboard.
